verdict.rationale: Datalab is a document-intelligence API. Its documented 'agent processor' feature (datalab-docs-40) makes an MCP-client capability a plausible ask, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows the product can connect to external MCP servers or use their tools; the docs cover conversion, extraction, pipelines, webhooks, the SDK and the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
